title: Show the Windows Update history
description: List the last 50 installed updates with their status

examples.description: Show every property of the first returned object. Select-Object * widens the output to every column, -First 1 keeps the first result. Use it to discover the available properties before filtering.
Export the results to a CSV file Excel can open. -NoTypeInformation drops the metadata line, -Encoding UTF8 keeps accented characters intact. Useful for archiving, reports and external analysis.
Count the returned objects. Measure-Object returns Count, Sum, Average, Min and Max depending on the properties. Useful for quick statistics and checking results.
List the last 50 installed updates with their status.

notes: Does not require administrator rights. Shows the installed KBs with their date.
